properties.source: Over the sea: streamline of the June surface wind in the NOAA PSL ICOADS 2-degree monthly long-term mean 1971-2000 (public domain), traced by script and simplified. South China Sea branch onto the south China coast; the run north-east inland toward the Yangtze is schematic. June is the Meiyu/Baiu season (mid-June to mid-July over the Yangtze valley and Japan); the front itself is not drawn.
refs: NOAA PSL ICOADS 2-degree enhanced monthly LTM 1971-2000, ERDDAP esrlIcoads2gec71 (accessed 2026-10-12)
